description: Palak Paneer is a quintessential Indian vegetarian dish, featuring tender spinach puree combined with soft cubes of paneer Indian cottage cheese. This vibrant green curry is subtly spiced, offering a delightful balance of earthy flavors and creamy texture. It's a wholesome and satisfying meal, perfect with naan or rice.

ingredients.notes: slit or finely chopped, adjust to taste

instructions.title: Prepare the Spinach
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the roughly chopped spinach and blanch for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Immediately drain the spinach and transfer it to a bowl of ice-cold water to retain its vibrant green color. Once cooled, squeeze out excess water and blend the spinach into a smooth puree. Set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Paneer
instructions.text: Cut the paneer into 1-inch cubes. You can pan-fry the paneer cubes in a little oil or ghee until lightly golden on all sides for a slightly firmer texture, or use them directly. If frying, remove and set aside.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics
instructions.text: Heat ghee or oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or kadai over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add the finely chopped onions and sauté until they turn translucent and light golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Add the ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, and cook for another 1-2 minutes until the raw aroma disappears.

instructions.title: Add Tomatoes and Spices
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato puree and cook until the oil starts to separate from the mixture, about 3-5 minutes. Add turmeric powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well and cook for 1 minute, ensuring the spices are well incorporated and fragrant.

instructions.title: Combine with Spinach and Simmer
instructions.text: Pour the spinach puree into the pan. Mix thoroughly with the onion-tomato masala. Add about 1/4 cup of water to adjust the consistency if needed. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld. Stir occasionally to prevent sticking.

instructions.title: Finish the Curry
instructions.text: Add the paneer cubes to the simmering spinach curry. Gently mix. Stir in the garam masala and crushed Kasuri Methi. If desired, add fresh cream or cashew paste for a richer, creamier texture. Cook for another 2-3 minutes until the paneer is heated through and the flavors are fully developed. Taste and adjust seasoning if necessary.

tips: To prevent spinach from losing its vibrant green color, always blanch it briefly and then immediately shock it in ice-cold water before pureeing.

For extra richness and a smoother texture, you can add 1-2 tablespoons of cashew paste or fresh cream at the end of cooking. Soaking cashews in warm water for 15 minutes and then blending them into a smooth paste works wonderfully.
Serve Palak Paneer hot with fresh naan, roti, paratha, or jeera rice. A dollop of fresh cream or a sprinkle of grated ginger can be added as a garnish just before serving.
